categories.main_business_segments: Hebei Sailhero Environmental Protection High-tech Co., Ltd. operates primarily in environmental monitoring, environmental management, and environmental governance services. Its business includes ecological environment monitoring systems, carbon emission monitoring and management services, ecological big data and decision support, natural ecological monitoring, operation and maintenance services, industrial pollution treatment, regional sewage treatment, socialized environmental testing, and new energy project development and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IoT, big data, cloud computing, AI, 5G, and advanced sensing technologies to build integrated environmental monitoring and management platforms. It develops proprietary monitoring equipment such as air quality continuous automatic monitoring systems, high spectral scanning imaging systems for water ecology, portable particle monitoring instruments, and AI-assisted biological diversity observation systems. It also innovates in VOCs treatment technologies, low-temperature deep denitrification for gas boilers, and distributed sewage treatment systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government environmental protection agencies at various levels, industrial parks, enterprises requiring environmental monitoring and pollution control, and regional ecological management authorities. The company serves markets focused on air quality, water quality, ecological environment, carbon emission management, and environmental governance in urban and industrial settings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant projects and subsidiaries across multiple provinces and cities. It also has overseas subsidiaries and operations in the United States and Europe, including environmental services and technology development in the US and the Netherlands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hebei Sailhero operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection industry supply chain, providing environmental monitoring equipment manufacturing, integrated environmental data services, consulting, and environmental governance solutions. It also extends upstream into new energy project development and investment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in environmental monitoring technologies, including portable high-precision particulate matter monitors, VOCs monitoring and treatment, ozone monitoring systems, AI-assisted ecological monitoring, and high spectral imaging for water quality. It focuses on digital transformation of environmental monitoring, ecological big data platforms, and integrated environmental governance ‘ecological brain’ solutions. R&D investments target innovation in IoT, AI, and cloud computing to enhance environmental data accuracy and management efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of environmental monitoring instruments and systems, operation and maintenance services, environmental consulting and management services, and new energy project development and operation. The company also earns income from leasing and other ancillary services, with a predominant direct sales model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in China's environmental monitoring and governance market, maintaining high market shares in conventional air monitoring and grid-based monitoring sectors. It competes with other domestic environmental technology firms and benefits from comprehensive product lines and integrated service capabilities. Its brand is recognized for quality and innovation in environmental protection solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 952.5 million RMB, a slight decrease of 1.44% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 152.4 million RMB. Total assets stood at approximately 2.06 billion RMB with net assets of 1.63 billion RMB. The company has experienced negative profitability in recent years but continues to invest in R&D and expand its market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hebei Sailhero emphasizes its full-industry-chain service advantage, integrating monitoring, consulting, and governance to provide one-stop environmental improvement solutions. Its products and services are distinguished by advanced IoT and big data integration, high accuracy and reliability, and comprehensive environmental data analytics. The company’s ecological brain platform and grid-based monitoring systems enable precise pollution source identification and intelligent environmental management, supporting sustainable development and government environmental goals.
